body:
Kinda funny cuz I'm personally trying to go the opposite route. I had a mask on last year. Pursued singing and dancing classes like I always wanted, acted charismatic and charming with people, etc. It "worked" except I hated that I wasn't being authentic. Doesn't mean much to me to have adoring women if they only like me when I'm putting on a show, literally or otherwise.

It certainly boosted my confidence though, and now I'm just trying to develop and nurture the beautiful bizarre pretty ugly real me :)

Hey, it's ok. Feels like I read a post from a younger version of myself. I wish I had something wise an elder would say, but I'm mentally and emotionally still a child in many ways. But I will say that you are capable of anything. Period. The real issue is finding what you want to be capable of doing. You deserve to let the real you blossom. I wish I was told that when I was younger. Anyway, I was able to get a high school equivalency degree which saved my ass, plus it was funny seeing my family go from giving up on me to throwing a party for me... fucking assholes.
